teaser.en: Drive the south coast road in season and you will see piles of green-skinned oranges for sale at the roadside.
teaser.sw: Ukiendesha gari kwenye barabara ya pwani ya kusini msimu ukifika, utaona marundo ya machungwa yenye maganda ya kijani yakiuzwa kando ya barabara.
teaser.dg: Uchiphiya na gari kpwenye njira ya pwani ya kusini wakati wa machungbwa, undaona vifungu vya machungbwa ga chijani ganaguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira.

summary.en: *Mchungwa* is the sweet orange, an evergreen citrus tree grown on farms and around homesteads. South coast oranges are sold at roadsides and eaten fresh or as juice.
summary.sw: *Mchungwa* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wa jamii ya machungwa unaopandwa mashambani na kuzunguka makazi. Machungwa ya pwani ya kusini huuzwa kando ya barabara na kuliwa kama yalivyo au kukamuliwa sharubati.
summary.dg: *Mchungwa* ni muhi wa machungbwa ga mtswano, muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa jamii ya ndimu, unaophandwa minda na kuzunguluka midzi. Machungbwa ga pwani ya kusini nkuguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira, na nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuminywa madzige.

about.en:
*Mchungwa* is an evergreen tree with a rounded crown, glossy dark green leaves and sometimes small thorns. Its white flowers are strongly scented.

The fruits, *chungbwa*, are round, with a thick, fragrant skin. In the warm coastal climate, the skin often stays green or greenish-yellow even when the fruit inside is ripe and sweet.
about.sw:
*Mchungwa* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wenye taji la mviringo, majani ya kijani kibichi kilichokolea yanayong'aa, na wakati mwingine miiba midogo. Maua yake meupe yana harufu kali nzuri.

Matunda, *chungbwa*, ni ya mviringo, yenye ganda nene lenye harufu nzuri. Katika hali ya joto ya pwani, mara nyingi ganda hubaki la kijani au kijani-manjano hata tunda likiwa limeiva na tamu ndani.
about.dg:
*Mchungwa* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati, wenye chitswa cha mviringo, makodza ganaala ga rangi ya chijani iriyokola, na wakati wanjina miya midide. Maruwage ga rangi nyereru gana arufu nono kali.

Matundage, *chungbwa*, ni ga mviringo, na gada nene renye arufu nono. Kpwa sababu ya dzoho ra pwani, mara nyinji gada rinasala ra chijani au ra chijani na rangi ya mandano, ela tunda ndani rikaivwa na ri ra mtswano.

where.en: Orange trees grow on farms and around homesteads along the south coast. In season, the fruit is sold at roadside stalls.
where.sw: Michungwa hukua mashambani na kuzunguka makazi kando ya pwani ya kusini. Wakati wa msimu, matunda huuzwa kwenye vibanda kando ya barabara.
where.dg: Michungwa inamera kpwenye minda na kuzunguluka midzi kanda-kanda ya pwani ya kusini. Wakati wa machungbwa, matunda nkuguzwa kpwenye vibanda kanda-kanda ya njira.

uses.en: Oranges are eaten fresh and squeezed for juice. They are also sold for cash, often at roadsides.
uses.sw: Machungwa huliwa kama yalivyo na hukamuliwa kupata sharubati. Pia huuzwa kwa pesa, mara nyingi kando ya barabara.
uses.dg: Machungbwa nkuriwa dza garivyo na nkuminywa kuphaha madzige. Piya nkuguzwa kuphaha pesa, mara nyinji kanda-kanda ya njira.

names.en: Digo: *mchungwa* for the tree and *chungbwa* for the fruit. Swahili: *mchungwa*, with the fruit called *chungwa*. English: sweet orange. Scientists call it *Citrus sinensis*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchungwa* kwa mti na *chungbwa* kwa tunda. Kiswahili: *mchungwa*, na tunda huitwa *chungwa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *sweet orange*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus sinensis*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mchungwa* kpwa muhi na *chungbwa* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chiswahili: *mchungwa*, na tunda nkuihwa *chungwa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *sweet orange*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Citrus sinensis*.

reason.sw: Mchenza, jamaa wa karibu wa jamii ya machungwa
reason.dg: Mchendza, nduguye wa phephi wa jamii ya ndimu

reason.sw: Mdimu, mti mwingine wa nyumbani wa jamii ya machungwa
reason.dg: Mdimu, muhi wanjina wa jamii ya ndimu wa mudzini

reason.en: Mango, another fruit sold at roadsides
reason.sw: Mwembe, tunda lingine linalouzwa kando ya barabara
reason.dg: Mwembe, matundage piya nkuguzwa kanda-kanda ya njira

definition.en: An orange (the fruit). Pakia spells it chungwa, with the tree mchungwa.
definition.sw: Chungwa (tunda). Pakia huliandika chungwa, na mti mchungwa.
definition.dg: Tunda ra mchungwa. Pakia anariandika *chungwa*, na muhi *mchungwa*.

taxon.note: GBIF backbone lists C. sinensis as a synonym of C. aurantium (sour orange); POWO accepts Citrus × sinensis for sweet orange. Hand fix 2026-10-10.
